digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime and provider layer (runner.py, providers.py, bedrock_model.py, anthropic_model.py, structured.py)
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped in practice despite being provider-agnostic in principle, with hardcoded provider-name branches and refusal of base_url/api_key configuration that contradicts published documentation
Bedrock-hosted Anthropic models are not supported, requiring clients to use gateway proxies that lose prompt caching, retrying, read timeout, and native structured output capability
the resolved model string recorded in signed verdict sidecars no longer correctly identifies which provider actually answered when using non-Anthropic backends
documentation claims base_url and api_key configuration work but the code actively refuses them via _pai_check_config guard
Bedrock retry and timeout configuration do not reach the BedrockProvider; tenacity envelope and httpx.Timeout exist only on direct-Anthropic path making the production-live path unconfigured
